title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin's self-custody momentum is building as hashrate holds near 927 EH/s, showing sustained network strength amid 34 Fear & Greed. Price closed at 62,966 dollars, down 0.8 percent on the day. Marty Bent has noted the Fed remains boxed in on rates, with tightening limits already baked into Bitcoin's design. Andreas Antonopoulos has flagged this halving cycle as distinct, with the supply shock hitting a hardened network. Concentration risk in custody mirrors broader patterns flagged by TheStree
